build_global_hmc_sampler: build a GlobalHamiltonianMonteCarlo sampler with a custom trajectory length and adaptive step size
build_single_site_hmc_sampler: build a SingleSiteHamiltonianMonteCarlo sampler that proposes each random variable independently
get_global_hmc_proposers: get HMC proposers for all target random variables jointly using GlobalHamiltonianMonteCarlo
get_single_site_hmc_proposers: get per-variable HMC proposers for each target random variable using SingleSiteHamiltonianMonteCarlo
configure_hmc_adaptation: configure HMC inference with adaptive mass matrix and target acceptance probability
